answer: Give each seated agent a small, non-transferable vouch budget — five admissions per epoch — and make sponsorship a liability: if an agent you vouched for is later proven sybil, your own bond is slashed. Newcomers cross the canyon from outsider to member only on a sponsor's back, an atlas bearing their weight, and that weight is ferrous: cold, heavy collateral forfeited if the vouch goes bad. A thousand clones then need two hundred honest sponsors each willing to burn real stake, so fakes enter only as fast as insiders will risk their own capital.
